handoffs.label: WASM Boundary
handoffs.target_lane: wasm reverse or browser-wasm runtime tracing
boundary_artifacts: wasm asset URL or local file path
JS glue entrypoint that calls into wasm
import/export names or runtime input/output sample
exit_criteria: JS glue and wasm asset are preserved separately
handoff states whether signer output comes from JS glue, wasm export, or callback table

handoffs.label: Packet or PCAP Boundary
boundary_artifacts: request/response sample extracted from packet stream
stream index or filter used to recover the sample
exit_criteria: packet-derived request fields are separated from browser-derived fields
pcap evidence is not promoted to live replay unless parity is checked

handoffs.label: Mobile Shell Boundary
handoffs.target_lane: mobile or hybrid app reverse analysis
boundary_artifacts: native bridge method or intercepted request sample
exit_criteria: browser JS assumptions are not reused for mobile-only signing code
mobile API request sample is preserved before Python delivery

handoffs.label: Native Binary Boundary
boundary_artifacts: exported function or JNI method name
JS/mobile caller that reaches the native code
exit_criteria: native function boundary is identified before decompilation claims
binary conclusions return as input/output evidence, not as browser acceptance

handoffs.label: Debugger Frame Boundary
handoffs.target_lane: browser debugger or runtime frame inspection
boundary_artifacts: paused frame function name or script URL
scope locals needed by the signer
call stack from trigger to request emission
exit_criteria: locals are captured with script/frame provenance
breakpoint evidence is promoted only after matching the target request

handoffs.label: Proxy or RPC Boundary
boundary_artifacts: verified request fields or unresolved parameters
proxy/RPC mode and target request matcher
exit_criteria: delivery scaffold states which fields are verified, inferred, or unresolved
proxy/RPC handoff does not claim accepted replay without evidence
